footer.disclaimer: Wuwa Archive — Not affiliated with Kuro Games

sections.dataCollectionText: We do NOT collect any personal data. All your pull history data is stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB and is never transmitted to our servers.
sections.localStorageText: All data is stored in your browser. You have full control over your data and can delete it at any time from the Settings page.
sections.proxyServerText: Our server only acts as a thin proxy to fetch data from the Kuro Games API. We do not store, log, or retain any data that passes through our server.
sections.cookiesText: We only use cookies for UI preferences such as theme (dark/light mode) and language settings. No tracking cookies or analytics cookies are used.
sections.thirdPartyText: We do not use any third-party analytics or tracking services. There are no Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or similar tools on this website.
sections.dataDeletionText: You can delete all your data at any time from the Settings page. Clearing your browser data will also remove all stored information.

sections.disclaimerText: Wuwa Archive is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Kuro Games or Wuthering Waves in any way. This is an independent, open-source project created by fans for fans.
sections.noWarrantyText: The service is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy of data or uninterrupted service.
sections.dataAccuracyText: We make reasonable efforts to ensure data accuracy, but we cannot guarantee that all pull records are captured or that statistics are 100% accurate.
sections.accountSafetyText: Our PowerShell script only reads log files and does not modify any game files. It cannot be used to gain advantages or compromise account security.
sections.openSourceText: The source code is available on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license. You are welcome to audit the code for transparency.
sections.userResponsibilityText: You are responsible for keeping your data backups safe. While we implement deduplication, we recommend regular exports of your data.
